'''Cremini Town''' (Japanese: '''シキミタウン''' ''Shikimi Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location found in [[Kanto]]. It appeared in ''[[AG168|Three Jynx and a Baby!]]''. The {{gdis|Battle Tower|III}}, led by [[Anabel]], can be found just outside of the town.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} visited Cremini Town in ''Three Jynx and a Baby!.'' {{an|May}} saw a {{p|Smoochum}} and was about to hold her until the group discovered that Smoochum was being protected by a trio of overprotective {{p|Jynx}}. While the group decided to leave Smoochum and the Jynx alone, {{TRT}} made plans to steal Smoochum. Ash's group was able to save Smoochum and gain the three Jynx's trust. The Smoochum subsequently evolved and became a fourth Jynx. Ash and his friends made plans to rest at Cremini Town until the next day, when they headed to the Battle Tower.
